answer: Each epoch, every identity must prove a live, unique human body behind its key in the meadow registry: the biometric template is hashed and stored on-ledger, and any duplicate template is rejected, so one person can never hold two identities. A replayed video fails the lantern challenge-response that demands fresh, random motion. A fake costs a whole new human plus a 50 POA stake that burns on a failed check: one hundred fakes need one hundred people, while one honest agent passes in 30 seconds and its timber record stays clean.
